controles.affirmation: Citation de l'URD sur le processus legislatif d'au moins deux ans et le modele preferred CCP
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025, section 2.1.1 Risk Factors, Regulatory Evolution Risk : "It should be noted that these proposals have yet to go through the lengthy legislative process which is expected to last at least two years, with the outcome currently uncertain in particular the \"preferred CCP\" model Euronext has been operating, and potential use of distributed ledger technology."

controles.affirmation: Les propositions sur la piste consolidee et l'acces a la compensation actions menacent directement le modele de contrepartie centrale preferentielle d'Euronext
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025 : "proposals relating to consolidated tape extension and changes to equity clearing open access provision may pose a risk to these business activities" ; et, dans le meme chapitre : "Possible improvements to be made to Euronext's supervisory set-up in the context of the Market Integration and Supervision Package could bring benefits by rationalising approvals requested by Euronext required to implement its strategic initiatives."
controles.correction_proposee: Le document ecrit "may pose a risk" (peuvent presenter un risque), pas "menacent directement". Il presente aussi explicitement un versant favorable du paquet, que l'ATT omet. Remplacer "menacent directement le modele" par "peuvent presenter un risque pour ces activites, avec une issue que le document qualifie d'incertaine", et mentionner que l'URD y voit aussi des benefices possibles de rationalisation des agrements.

controles.affirmation: Goodwill et actifs incorporels de 6 826,1 M€ contre 4 801,8 M€ de capitaux propres totaux (dont 4 613,1 M€ part du groupe) au 30 juin 2026
controles.verbatim_source: PR Q2 2026, Consolidated statement of financial position : "Goodwill and other intangible assets 6,826.1 6,845.1" ; "Shareholders' equity 4,613.1 4,728.8" ; "Total equity 4,801.8 4,951.6"
controles.correction_proposee: Remarque de forme : le libelle de la preuve ("Total non-current assets incluant Goodwill...") est ambigu, le total des actifs non courants etant de 7 545,0 M€. Ecrire simplement "poste Goodwill and other intangible assets".

controles.affirmation: Ratio de remuneration CEO/salarie moyen de 54,4x en 2025, contre 41,4x en 2024, 36,8x en 2023, 35,8x en 2022 et 34,6x en 2021
controles.verbatim_source: URD FY2025, rapport de remuneration : "2021 2022 2023 2024 2025 Group Chief Executive Officer Pay Ratio 34.6 35.8 36.8 41.4 54.4" ; methodologie : "the average annual remuneration of the employees is determined by dividing the total wage costs in the financial year by the average number of FTEs during the financial year. Excluding the Group CEO."

controles.affirmation: 1 844 emetteurs actions fin juin 2026 contre 1 912 un an plus tot (-3,6%)
controles.verbatim_source: PR Q2 2026, Business indicators : "Number of Issuers on Equities 1,844 1,912 -3.6%"

controles.affirmation: Ce repli intervient "apres un recul de 4,8% sur l'ensemble de 2025 (1 725 emetteurs)"
controles.verbatim_source: PR FY2025 : "Number of issuers on Equities - Euronext 1,725 1,812 -4.8%" ; PR Q2 2026 : "Number of Issuers on Equities 1,844 1,912 -3.6%" avec la note "Q2 2025 volumes are including Euronext Athens on a pro forma basis"
controles.correction_proposee: Les deux chiffres proviennent de series de perimetre different (ligne "Euronext" hors Athenes dans le communique FY2025, ligne globale ensuite). Les enchainer laisse croire a une serie continue 1 725 puis 1 844, ce qui est impossible avec 76 nouvelles cotations par an. Presenter les deux constats separement, ou n'utiliser que la serie Q2 2026 vs Q2 2025.

controles.affirmation: 76 nouvelles cotations en 2025, +13,4% par rapport a 2024
controles.verbatim_source: PR FY2025 : "Number of new equity listings 76 67 +13.4%"

controles.affirmation: Meilleure dynamique de cotations primaires depuis 2023 au deuxieme trimestre 2026
controles.verbatim_source: PR Q2 2026 : "This renewed momentum was driven by the strongest admission activity and follow-on transactions volumes since 2023 despite a volatile market environment."

controles.affirmation: L'ajustement final de juste valeur d'Admincontrol a reduit le chiffre d'affaires publie de 0,9 M€ au T2 2026 ; levier 1,3x ; acquisition d'Athenes en novembre 2025
controles.verbatim_source: PR Q2 2026 : "The remainder was released in 2026, reducing reported revenue by €0.9 million in Q2 2026, with no impact on cash and cash equivalents" ; "Net debt to EBITDA was at 1.3x at the end of June 2026, within Euronext's target range of the 'Innovate for Growth 2027' strategic plan" ; "In November 2025, Euronext acquired a majority stake in the Athens Stock Exchange (ATHEX)"
